reason: For Harvard or Oxford I want a person who runs the whole thing and calls me, not a website my child has to drive alone. At $99 it looks like a software tool, not a service that takes this off my plate.
objection: Who actually does the work? Practice applications and a dated plan still leave my child and me doing everything, and $99 is so cheap I doubt a real expert reviews the essays for top universities.
would_change_my_mind: A named counsellor who has placed Central Asian students at top US/UK universities, manages the deadlines and submissions, and calls me in Russian every week, even at a much higher price.
